tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /yi dam chos srung rnams kyi gtor bsngo bskang ba phyogs gcig bsgrigs pa 'phrin las dpal grub bzhugs so// na mo gu ru dā+e wa maṇ+ḍal dharmā pā la ya/ dbang bzhis smin mdzad lam bzhis grol ston pa'i/ /sku bzhi'i bdag nyid bla ma bzhir btud nas/ /yi dam chos srung gtor bsngo bskang ba'i khrigs/ /dang po'i las can don du bshad kyis nyon/ de la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ gnas dben par srung ma rnams kyi bris sku dang / rten bshams pa'i mdun du stegs bu ras bzang po dang / dar zab kyi brgyan pa'i steng du/ 'bru sna tshogs kyis gcal du bkram/ de'i steng du gser dngul gyi snod dam/ zangs gzhong ngam/ ma 'byor na shing gzhong ngam/ rdza las kyang rung ste/ bse'i snod du ni mi bya'o/ /snod de rnams su/ dang po 'das pa'i gtor ma/ gnyis pa nag po chen po/ gsum pa dpal ldan lha mo/ bzhi pa lcags kyi snod dam/ sngar smos pa'i smad du mgon po gdong bzhi pa/ lnga pa pu tra ming sring / drug pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor/ de nas lha mo nam mkha'i gos can dang / bse khrab/ gzhi bdag rnams la gong bzhin zlum gtor re re te gtor bsngo'i gtor ma dam rdzas bcu chang / de thams cad kyang zan bzang po la 'bras dang gro la sogs pa'i 'bru sna tshogs bsres pa'i snying po zlum po pad ma'i snying po ltar zlum zhing / rtse mo cung zad rno bar byas pa'i mthar mtheb kyu pad+ma'i 'dab ma'i tshul du bskor bar bya bar rdo rje mchu'i dam tshig gis gzungs las bshad cing / gru gsum sogs su bya ba chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen pos bkag pas mi bya'o/ /bla ma kun dga' grags kyi lag len la 'das gtor/ mkha' 'gro spyi gzhi bdag gsum zlum po/ mgon po dang lha mo gnyis kyi rtsa gsum gnyis man zlum po/ stod sum cha zur gsum mi rno ba/ gdong bzhi pa de dang 'dra ba la snying po'i phyogs bzhir yum bzhi'i bshos bu zur gsum rno ba bzhi bya/

pu tra la snying po gru bzhi pa rtse mo rim gyis phra ba byas pa la/ phyogs bzhi nas gru gsum pa mnyam po bzhi sbyar bas zur brgyad du byas pa la/ drag gtor zur brgyad pa zer bas de ltar bya gsung ngo / /de ltar byed la gtor dbyibs rang rang gi gzhung bzhin gtor ma thams cad la mar dang sbrang rtsi dang thud bu ram sogs zas bzang dgu sna tshogs pa dang / bsad pa ma yin pa'i sha btsos pa sna tshogs dang / bre brag tu mgon po dang lha mo la kha na ma tho ba med pa'i sha sna tshogs mar du btsos pa bag zan dang lhan cig byas pa dzaṃ bu ḍi ka'i mchod pa mang du brgyan/ gzhan yang ma dus dang / la phug dang / sgog btsong dang / chang sna tshogs pa dang bcas par bshams/ de dag la dar sna tshogs kyi gur ram ba dan rgyan du mas spras pa la/ mu tig dang gser g.yu dang / byi ru la sogs pa rin po che'i du mas spras pa btsugs/ de'i mdun du bskang gtor gong gi gtor rdzas las grub pa'i gur la gru gsum gcig de'i g.yon du lha mo la gru gsum gcig gi mdun gru gsum gcus gtor brtsigs/ mgon po'i g.yas su zhal la gru gsum gcig gi phyogs bzhi gru gsum de'i phyed zin tsam re/ de'i g.yas su pu tra sogs las mkhan la gru gsum brtsigs te 'di rnams mgon po'i man ngag nas 'byung ba'i zhi ba dam rdzas rgyan ldan gyi gtor ma yin pas dbyibs gru gsum 'o na gong du gru gsum bkag pa dang 'gal lo snyam na mi 'gal te brgyud pa'i man ngag las 'byung ba'i phyir ro// yod kyang zur rtse shin tu zlum nyams can la/ smug rtsi kho na'o/ /yang na gur la dbus nag mtha' dmar/ lha mo dang zhal la dbus dmar mtha' nag las mkhan la dbus nag mtha' dmar/ rtse rgyan spros pa la dga' na me ris kyi khrod gur la pad+ma'i steng thod pa gaṇ+ḍe gri gug rnams brtsigs pa/ lha mor gzhan gong bzhin la rtser bum pa/ de'i 'og tu ral gri thod pa pad+ma la gnas pa/

zhal gzhan gong bzhin la pad+ma'i steng thod pa rkang gling khri rnams brtsigs pa/ las mkhan la gzhan gong bzhin la pad+ma'i steng thod pa ral gri gtor sdems la sgor rgyan dang / zur la me ris sogs gang 'os/ lha mo'i g.yon nas bsgrigs pa'i gtor dbyibs so so'i gzhung bzhin/ de rnams kyi mdun du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga dang / khyad par mgon po la yungs dkar dang gu gul bdug tshil chen rnams bsres pa'i bdug spos bshams/ gzhan yang nang mchod/ rdo rje dril bu/ rnga rol rkang gling sogs nyer bar mkho ba thams cad bsham mo/ /gtor ma rnams bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba'i chang ngam/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i chang dang / chu gtsang / chang phal pa rnams kyi sbyangs/ spos kyi bdug gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ ༈ /thog mar mchod rdzas rnams la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhās bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ nas/ shap+ta'i bar 'bru gsum spel ba'i mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe te/ pra tsa li ni/ pradzñā pā ra mi ta/ nā da swa bha we na badz+ra dharmā hri da ya ni san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho āḥkhaṃ swāhā/ lan gsum/ rol chen dang bcas pas byin gyi dbab/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/

'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la༞ dam pa'i chos rnams༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'di bar lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ /sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma klu brgyad bsnol ba'i steng du hrīḥlas pad+ma hrīḥs mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal dmar po/ g.yas zhal ljang gu/ g.yon zhal dkar po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal bsgrad pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing / ljags 'dril ba/ smin ma dang sma ra/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ dbu gsum gyi gtsug na rta mgo ljang gu gsum kha gdangs shing rta skad 'tsher ba/ rngog ma'i gseb nas me stag 'phro bas stong gsum gang ba/ phyag drug g.yas kyi dang po na rdo rje/ gnyis pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga gsum pa na ral gri/ g.yon gyi dang po na sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pa na mdung thung / gsum pa na rgyu zhags 'dzin pa/ glang chen gyi ko rlon dang / zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhis stod g.yogs pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/

mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ mi skra'i tshangs skud dang / khrag gi thig le/ zhag gi zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bus brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas pa bzhi bskum zhing / g.yon pa bzhi brkyangs pas klu chen po brgyad sbrul gyi rnam par brdzis pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du bzhugs pa/ de'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad rta mgrin mtshon gang bas go mtshams med par gtams pa rang dang de thams cad kyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra 'brug stong ltar sgrog cing me dpung 'bar bas gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad gzhob thul thul bsreg par gyur/ oṃ hrīḥpad+man+takṛta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brgya stong la sogs pa bzlas pa'o/ /bzlas pa'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra dun bh+yoḥ tig nan hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥ sa mā ya dzaḥ sa mā ya bzlog sa mā ya bh+yoḥ sa ma ya gtubs/ sa mā ya byer/ sa mā ya rbad/ sa ma ya rbad rbud phaṭa ya 'byung po mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes pa'i drag sngags 'di yang nyer gcig tsam re bzlas pa'i mthar/ phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bcug la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ gtor bsngo bskang ba'i gtor ma gang yod dus gcig la byin brlabs pa ni/ gtor ma rnams/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhās bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shūd+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shūd+dho3haṃ/ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu brdungs pa lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/

de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng gi shar du go las ba glang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha sha de rnams re re'i steng du yang / shar du bh+rūm̐ las dri chen/ lhor aṃ las rak+ta/ nub tu dz+rīṃ las byang sems/ byang du khaṃ las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu/ de rnams kyi steng du bh+rūm̐ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ lhor aṃ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ nub tu dz+rīṃ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/ byang du khaṃ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ dbus su hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ zla ba'i mthar g.yon bskor gyis/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ āḥ g.yas skor gyis ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzña nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa dha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du bltas pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas/ rlung gi ba dan la phog pas rlung g.yos me sbar bas sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga rnams bskol zhing 'od du zhu ba'i rlangs pa gyen la song bas oṃ dang rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag yang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis thugs ka nas yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnams he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par byon te rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ la thim pas rdo rje brjid dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje nyi ma oṃ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung ba 'od du zhu nas sngar gyi bdud rtsi rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur te kha dog dang dri dang ro dang nus pa phun sum tshogs pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes lan gsum mam lnga brjod de byin gyis brlabs la/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar e e e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum sum brtsegs kyi nang du paṃ paṃ paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa re re/ steng gi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la oṃ dgu yongs su gyur pa las dbus su sku rdo rje/ shar du dbang phyug chen po/ lhor lha'i dbang po/ nub tu tshangs pa/ byang du khyab 'jug shar lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ lho nub tu tshogs kyi bdag po/ nub byang du bh+riṃ gi ri ti/ byang shar du gzhon nu karti ka ste thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i rigs ma la 'khyud pa/ bar gyi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte bar dbus su hūm̐ las dpal kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po g.yas dkar g.yon dmar steng zhal dud kha/ zhal lhag ma gnyis gnag pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po/ g.yon gyi dang po na sa yi lha ser po/ de gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang ser po/ lnga pa na rnga mo thal kha/ drug pa na mi dmar po/ bdun pa na sha ra bha sngon po/ brgyad pa na byi bla gwa pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na chu'i lha dkar po/ gsum pa na me'i lha dmar po/ bzhi pa na rlung gi lha ljang gu/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha dkar po/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha dmar po/ bdun pa na gshin rje sngon po/ brgyad pa na nor 'dzin ser po/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan zhing /

rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas gnyis brkyangs pa'i brla la g.yon pa gnyis bskums pa'i ser mo rnams gtad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sgeg cing dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung / /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yi/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /de'i pang na aṃ las yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs shing g.yas bskums pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ shar du gaṃ las gau rī nag mo g.yas gri gug g.yon nya ro hi 'dzin pa/ lhor tsaṃ las tsau rī dmar mo g.yas cang te'u/ g.yon phag pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu baṃ las bait+ta lī ser mo g.yas rus sbal g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang du ghaṃ las ghasma rī ljang gu g.yas sbrul g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du paṃ las puk+ka sī sngon mo g.yas seng ge g.yon dgra satwa 'dzin pa/ shar lhor shaṃ las ri khrod ma dkar mo g.yas dge slong / g.yon gsil byed 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu laṃ las gdol pa mo sngo dmar g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon thong gshol 'dzin pa/ nub byang du ḍaṃ las g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs pa g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum ma/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan zhing / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa'i dkyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la hūm̐ brgyad yongs su gyur ba las/

shar du brgya byin/ lhor gshin rje/ nub tu chu lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ shar lhor me lha/ lho nub tu srin po/ nub byang du rlung lha/ byang shar du dbang ldan te thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i rig ma la 'khyud pa/ 'og gi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la āḥdagu yongs su gyur pa las dbus su gsung rdo rje/ shar du stobs kyi rgyu/ lhor dung skyong / nub tu mtha' yas/ byang du nor rgyas/ shar lhor 'jog po/ lho nub tu rigs ldan/ nub byang du pad+ma/ byang shar du pad+ma chen po ste thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i rigs ma la 'khyud pa/ 'byung po nyer bzhi po 'di dag thams cad pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas steng gi lha thams cad lha chen brgyad la thim/ sa steng na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad phyogs skyong brgyad la thim/ sa 'og na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad klu chen brgyad la thim/ de thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dpal kyai rdo rje lha dgu sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang / se gol gyi sgras spyan drangs/ khu tshur g.yon gyi mthe'u chung dang g.yas pa'i mdzub mo sbril te/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī āḥkar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes dang khu tshur gnyis rgyab sprad zhags mig ltar byas la/

oṃ badz+ra tsau rī pra be sha ya hūm̐/ zhes dang mthe'u chung dang mdzub mo phan tshun sbrel te/ oṃ badz+ra bait+ta lī ban+dha baṃ/ zhes dang / khu tshur bcangs ba'i mkhrig ma gnyis bsnol te/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru ho/ zhes brjod/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ thal mo sbyar te/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing / /puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u rdung / 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen por rjes chags pas/ /g.yung mor sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /ces mchod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyis/ /khyed kyi bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams he ru ka'i gzugs su gyur nas rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chu spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lus pa las sku rdo rje lha chen brgyad dang bcas pa la rnam par snang mdzad/ gtso bo yab yum gau rī dang puk+ka sī la mi bskyod pa/ tsau rī dang sha ba ri la rnam par snang mdzad/ bait+ta lī dang tsaṇ+ḍa lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ghasma rī dang ḍā+oṃ bi ni la 'od dpag med/ phyogs skyong brgyad la mi bskyod pa/ gsung rdo rje klu chen brgyad dang bcas pa la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pā ri wā ra oṃ ni ri hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/

oṃ badz+ra nī wi ti hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swāhā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ kha raṃ ma hā ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swāhā/ zhes pa rnams phyag rgya dang bcas pas chu bzhi phul/ lha rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje nas 'bras tsam gyis mtshan pa las 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas gtor ma drangs te gsol bar bsam zhing / pad kor sngon du 'gro bas/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pā ri wā ra/ oṃ in+d+ra/ dza ma/ dza la/ dzak+kha/ bhu ta/ bah+ni/ bā u rak+kha/ tsan+da/ sudz+dza/ ma da/ p+papa/ ta la pā tā li/ aṭ+ṭa sap+pa swāhā/ i daṃ ba liṃ bhudzña dzi gha/ phul+la/ dhup+pa/ maṃ sa/ piṃgha/ am+bha/ sap+pa/ kadz+dza/ sā da/ khan+ti khu ṇi/ phe ṭa/ gā da/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ a d+ya nuta pan+na twad oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes brjod cing / se gol brdab/ de lta bu gsum mam lnga la sogs pas gtor ma phul la/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra bar sbyar la/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta/ zhes pas mchod/ hūm̐ aṃ gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ laṃ ḍaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kyai rdo rje sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /zhes dang / mthe bo'am thor mas nang mchod phul la/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i thal mo dang / dril bu sum brdung bya zhing / dkar mo ri dwags/ sogs nas/ 'khyud pa nyid/ ces pa'i bar dang / khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ /khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog brnyes pa/ /khyod kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan te/ /snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad pa/ /sgyu ma'i spros pa rdo rje grub pa'i yid/ /he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dgyes/ /mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /mi bskyod dbyings ni mkhas chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/

/rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gror༞ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gror༞ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog rdo rje nam mkha' 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gror༞ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung / /sna tshogs mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal stod/ /ces bstod/ rdo rje thugs khar bzung dril bu chig rdung bya zhing / lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /srin po'i tshogs rnams༞ /'byung po'i༞ /yi dwags༞ /sha za'i༞ /smyo byed༞ /brjed byed tshogs༞ /mkha' 'gro'i༞ /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs/ /ma lus ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun 'thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang / /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces phrin gzhol/ gtor ma gzhan rnams kyis byin rlabs lnga dus gcig la grub zin yang /

byin rlabs dran pa'i phyir 'das gtor la lag pa g.yon pa bstan te/ oṃ zhes brjod pas stong par bsam/ g.yas pa bstan te/ āḥzhes brjod pas thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ gnyis ka bstan te hūm̐ zhes brjod pas sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang ba/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan te/ ha ho hrīḥzhes brjod pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsams la/ lan gsum brjod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma klu brgyad bsnol ba'i steng du/ hrīḥlas pad+ma hrīḥs mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur/ khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rta mgrin sku mdog ces sogs gong bzhin la/ gzhob thul thul sregs pa'i sku can du gyur pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rta mgrin gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lus pa las bla ma'i ngo bo 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ hrīḥpad+man+ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ i daṃ ba liṃ bhu dza kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba sha truṃn bigh+nan mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza pad+ma he ru ka sa pā ri wā ra/ sngon du 'gro bas chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo rnams/ pra tīts+tsha swāhā'i mtha' can gyi mchod/ mtshan sngags la/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes sman rag gis mchod/ hrīḥ spyan ras gzigs sprul hrīḥlas khro bo'i sku/ /chos rje 'od dpag med pa rdo rje chos/

/log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral pad+ma dmar po'i steng / /'khor ba'i 'dam skem tsha zer rgyas pa'i dbus/ /dug lnga'i rang bzhin klu chen gdan stengs su/ brkyang bskums rol pas bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro la rjes chags sku mdog dmar ba'i mdangs/ /log 'dren tshar gcod rtsa zhal mche ba gtsigs/ /g.yas g.yon sngo dkar khro dang 'dod pa'i nyams/ /sku gsum zhal ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum gzigs pa'i spyan gsum nyi ltar 'khyil/ dug gsum tshar gcod mche gtsigs ljags 'dril bzhad/ /khams gsum dbang sdud skra smin sma ra 'bar/ /sna tshogs nyams ldan khyod la༞ /rta mgo ljang zhur drag po'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ /gnas gsum ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang sdud cing / /gdon bgegs log 'dren kun gyi snying rab 'gas/ /srid gsum g.yo mdzad khyod la༞ /rngog ma'i gseb nas me stag 'phros pa yis/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu yongs khyab pa'i/ /ye shes me dpung rwa ba bla bre gur/ /bar chad kun 'joms khyod la༞ /phyag drug g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /me 'bar ral gri 'phyar ba'i stangs stabs kyis/ /ma rig bdud dpung phye mar 'thag mdzad pa'i/ /mthu stobs bsam yas khyod la༞ /g.yon gsum sdigs mdzub mdung thung rgyu zhags kyis/ /gdug can gzir dang nyon mongs kun 'bigs shing / /bgegs kun 'ching zhing snod bcud dbang sdud pa'i/ /dgos pa dpag med khyod la༞ /pha rol phyin drug dag pas phyag rgya drug /'khor 'das dpal 'byor stsol ba'i rin chen rgyan/ /dug lnga'i klu 'dul sbrul gyi chun po sogs/ /rgyal kun 'dzin pa khyod la༞ /glang lpags zhing chen stag gi sham thabs sogs/ /ru tra dpa' bkong na bza' lhab lhub g.yo/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i gzi 'od kyis/ /snod bcud zil gnon khyod la༞ /rgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung ba yi/

/bzhad pa'i nga ros rgyal kun mchod pa dang / /sgrub la mchog stsol ma rungs phyir 'thag pa'i/ /pad+ma dbang chen gsung la༞ /snying rje rngams dang zhi ba'i rol pa yis/ /'gro la brtse dang log 'dren tshar gcod cing / /bde stong zung 'jug ngang las g.yo med pa'i/ /pad+ma dbang chen thugs la༞ /khyod kyi yon tan dgos 'dod dbang rgyal dang / /'phrin las sna tshogs nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i/ /'khor ba ji srid sems can don mdzad pa/ /thugs rje che ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar khro rgyal rta mchog rol pa la/ /rtse gcig dad pas mchod dang bstod pa'i mthus/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde bum pa bzang po ltar/ /nam yang mi nub rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas la/ /sngon gyi las sam 'phral rkyen las gyur pa'i/ /sdig sgrib nad gdon byad kha rbod gtong sogs/ /mi mthun phyogs kun zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /khyod sku bsgom zhing gzungs sngags bzlas pa dang / /mi 'gyur bde chen ting 'dzin bsgoms pa'i mthus/ /tshe bsod dpal 'byor lung rtogs yon tan sogs/ /mthun rkyen ma lus rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /bstan 'gro'i don chen yun du bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bdag gi srid zhi'i dge legs ma lus kun/ /khab len rdo yis lcags phye sdud pa ltar/ /'bad med dbang du 'du bar mdzad du gsol/ /khyod ni rgyal ba'i drag po'i phrin las te/ /de phyir zhi bas mi thul dgra bgegs kun/ /skad cig nyid la thal ba rdul du rlog /mi mthun phyogs kun 'joms par mdzad du gsol/ /mdor na deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bdag sogs 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i yid can tshogs/ /khro rgyal rta mchog rol pas rjes bzung nas/ /gnas skabs mthar thug phan bde ma lus stsal/ /gtor ma gnyis pa dang gsum par lhan cig byin rlabs dran ched/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od 'phros dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje nag po chen po cher 'bar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs khar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/

phyag gnyis char gyi dbus na rnam 'phrul gyi gaṇ+ḍe bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod paṇa dang lhab lhub kyis bklubs pa/ mi'u thung gel pa'i 'dug stangs kyis ro'i steng na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas na bya nag g.yon na khyi nag rgyab na lce spyang / mdun na mi nag steng na nam mkha' lding gi sprul pa pho nya 'phro ba/ mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du ṭaṃ las e ka dza ṭi sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thugs khar 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi na bza' stod g.yogs shing / stag gis pags pa'i sham thabs can/ ral pa lan bu gcig tu gyur nas g.yon du 'phyang ba khro mo'i rnam pa can/ de'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang du trag las khrag gi rgya mtsho'i nang du bh+yoḥlas dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ bong bu gwa pa la zhon pa/ sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na mdung / gnyis pa na rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yog shing / ba lang gi ko bas smad g.yogs pa/ re lde'i sham thabs can/ klu'i dbang po'i ska rags bcings pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mi ro rengs pa khar bcug nas mche ba gtsigs pa/ snyan g.yas pa la dug sbrul dang g.yon pa la seng ges brgyan pa/ sku la khrag gi thig le dang / zhag gi zo ris dang thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ shin tu rid pa/ lte ba'i thad ka nas nyi zla 'char ba/

ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sde'i dbus na hūm̐ dang bh+yo'i sgra sgrog pa/ lcam dral gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas mgon po dang / rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang se gol gyi sgra bya/ thal mo khong stong sbyar/ mgon po'i dam rgya bcas te/ mdzub mo g.yas pa'i rdo rjes g.yab cing dril bu bcad gtubs su dkrol la/ mgon po kun gshegs gdan las bzhengs/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang / /shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /gnas 'dir nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la e h+ye hi/ zhes dang / sor mo phan tshun cung zad bsnol ba'i rdo rje thal mo sbyar la lha mo'i dam rgya g.yab pa'am/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ lha mo kun gshegs/ sogs nas/ gshegs su gsol/ oṃ ma hā kā lī de wī e h+ye hi/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ so so la thim/ thal mo sbyar ba'i sor mo dbus ma gsum so sor bskyed de/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ya staṃ/ zhes pas pad+ma'i gdan phul/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya gṛh+ne daṃ/ ma hā kā li de wī grih+ṇa daṃ ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ pā d+yaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ sogs nas/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ mgon po'i dam rgya snying gar bcas te de'i spyi bor bzhag par bsams la/ yi dam gyi nga rgyal brtan pos/ oṃ shrī mā hā kā lā ya sa mā ya sma ra/ sa mā ya mā ti kra ma/ sa mā ya rak+ṣan+tu/ lha mo'i dam bca' snying khar bcas te/ de'i spyi bor bzhag par bsams la/ oṃ ma hā kā lī de wī sa ma ya sma ra/ zhes sogs kyi dam la bzhag spro na/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' bstod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/

rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dam tshig srungs/ bstan pa skyongs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ khyad par du yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang / rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba dang / bdag gi lam sgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dor bar mdzad du gsol/ gal te zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul du ma 'tshal na/ gang la gang 'tshams pa'i chad pas bcad pa dang / bskrad cing gzir ba dang / dbye ba dang / bsdigs shing dpa' bkong bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa nas 'di bar thal mo brdab/ mdor na chos sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub cing bstan pa 'dzin pa dang / 'jig rten pa kun dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod cing thal mo brdab/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā sa pā ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shā mu me bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ urga te/ s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga khaṃ gṛh+ne daṃ ba liṃ di swāhā/ zhes gsum mam lnga dang / o shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa na u pa ha ri ṇi/ e ṣa/ a pash+tsi/ ma ka lo/ a yaṃ/ i daṃ/ rat+na tra yā yā/ a pa kā ri ṇi/ ya di pra tī dzña/ sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭa/ kha kha khā hi khā hi ma ra ma ra/ gṛh+na gṛh+na/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na/ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsum mam lngas mgon po dang / oṃ shrī ma hā kā li de wī sa pā ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te/ zhes sogs gsum mam lngas lha mo la phul te/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā yā gṛh+na daṃ/ zhes sogs nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis gong ltar mchod/ nang mchod phul te/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/

zhes dang / oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha/ ba dho sī ka ma la rak+kha sī hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang / bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing / mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas gdong bzhi pa'i gtor ma mgon po'i skabs ltar byin rlabs dran par byas la/ ༈ /mdun du paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa/ rtsa zhal brtsegs ma gnyis nag po/ g.yas g.yon gnyis ljang nag phyag bzhi'i g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod khrag thugs khar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas 'og mar ral gri dang / g.yon 'og mas rus 'phreng 'phyar stabs su 'dzin pa/ skra kham pa gyen du brdzes shing spyan gsum pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ma mchu 'phyang ba/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ tshangs pa'i skud pa dang rus pa dang sbrul gyis brgyan zhing / zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ drag la rngams pa'i cha lugs can/ ngag tu ha ha dang / hūm̐ hūm̐ dang / k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ gis sgra sgrog pa/ de'i g.yas su g.yung mo nag mo/ g.yon du gtum mo ljang gu/ mdun du srin mo dmar mo/ rgyab tu sing ga lī ma ser nag bzhi ka'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ gcer bu rgyan med pa rab tu grims shing khros pa'i cha lugs can/ g.yon brkyangs g.yas bskum bzhengs pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ gtso 'khor lnga ka'i dpral bar oṃ/ sogs nas/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas ti se/ bsil ba'i tshal/ po ta la/ ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod/

dar lung gnyan gyi pho brang / kha'u brag rdzong / dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang gi gnas nas nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pa'ang se gol gyi sgra bya thal mo sbyar ba'i srin lag nang du bkug la mdzub mo gung mo'i rgyab nas rā ltar byas pa rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya las mdzub mo g.yab pa'ang / rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /gtum po khyod kyis ji ltas khas blangs bzhin/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i las la spyan 'dren na/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ma hā kā lā tsa turmu kha sa pā ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ oṃ ma hā kā la tsa turmu kha sa pā ri wā ra gṛh+na daṃ ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ sogs gong bzhin/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya gong bzhin bcas la/ oṃ ma hā kā la tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya dha ra/ sogs nas/ 'jig rten pa kun dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ bar gong bzhin/ oṃ ma hā kā la bi kā la kā la ra ṭi ta ḍoṃ bhi nī/ tsan+ḍa li/ rak+kha sī/ siṅga lī de wī sa pā ri wā ra na maḥsarba/ sogs nas/ ba l+yā de swāhā/ bar gong bzhin/ mchod sngags gong bzhin/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la/ sogs nas/ siṅga lī de wī hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐/ gis bar mchod/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /zhes sogs gong ltar brjod/ de nas las mgon gyi gtor ma byin rlabs sngar ltar dran par byas la/ ༈ /mgon po'i thugs ka nas ya dang / lha mo'i thugs ka nas maṃ mdun du spros pas/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ ya las nag po gnod sbyin sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi gyon zhing / gser gyi rna cha can/ de'i g.yon du maṃ las nag mo gnod sbyin zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/

g.yas gser gyi spu gri/ g.yon klad khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ dar nag gi na bza' gyon zhing / byu ru'i lan tshar can/ de gnyis kyi thugs ka nas yab las tri gnyis dang yum las bh+yoḥgacig mdun du spros pa las pu tra ming sring gsum du gyur te/ tri las pu tra nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ral gri dang / g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ dar gyi ang ga rag dang / dar nag gis na bza' brgyan pa/ tri las bha ṭa nag po stag slog can/ g.yas dam shing dang g.yon mi'i snying 'dzin pa/ bh+yoḥlas sring mo ral gcig ma g.yas gser gyi spu gri dang / g.yon rgyu ma 'dzin zhing kha nas me 'bar ba/ lnga ka'ang sku mdog mthing nag rab tu khros pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ rus pa'i phreng ba dang mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal gyis brgyan pa/ rngams shing 'khrugs pas gdug pa can tshar gcod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ gzhan yang g.yas kyi ru 'dren pa skyes pa stag chas brgyan pa brgya/ g.yon gyi ru 'dren pa dge slong gi gzugs can brgya/ slad kyi rjes su 'brang ba sngags pa nag po brgya/ mdun gyi shugs byad 'dren pa bud med nag mo brgya/ gzhan yang dam nyams kyi rjes gcod pa'i bya nag khyi nag mi nag lce spyang la sogs pa pho nya bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas las kyi mgon po rnams la bka' bstod pho nya'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas thim par bsam/ mgon po'i skabs kyi dam rgya bcas te/ de rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag par bsam la/ oṃ a li a li ma dza dzaḥ shaṃ shaṃ li shi ded/ a shwa ded/ mo smugs/ pu tri/ a li ma dza dzaḥ nag mo sha la rub/ dza dzaḥ oṃ ro ru ro ru tri tsa pa la/ a shug me/ ma hūm̐ ma bh+yoḥ dzaḥdzaḥ sa ma ya sma ra/ sogs kyi dam la bzhag spro na/ las kyi mgon po bka' bstod pho nya 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/

zhes sogs kyis bka' bsgos la/ rdo rje thal mo phye ste/ a li a li ma/ sogs/ ma hūm̐ ma bh+yoḥdzaḥdzaḥ i daṃ ba liṃ bhuñdza/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa'i bar gsum mam lnga la sogs pas gtor ma 'bul la/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyi mchod nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis nang mchod 'bul te/ dam can gnod sbyin yab yum/ bka' bstod pu tra ming sring / sprul pa'i ru 'dren sde bzhi/ dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud/ pho nya las mgon dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /zhes sogs nas gong ltar brjod/ gtor ma byin rlabs dran pa gong bzhin/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du k+ṣa yig dmar nag de las 'od zer 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdugs pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje lha mo nam mkha'i gos can ma sku mdog sngo skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ mche ba gangs ri ltar gtsigs pa/ ljags glog ltar 'khyug pa/ mig khrag ltar dmar ba/ sdang ba'i dgra la 'bur tshugs su gzigs pa/ gcer bu skra grol ba/ zhing lpags dang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sku la til mar dang thal chen gyis byugs pa/ de'i g.yas g.yon du las kyi ma mo kha gdangs pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ mtshon cha sna tshogs pa thogs pa dpag tu med pas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal nas rdo rje lha mo nam mkha'i gos can ma 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bh+yoḥ dur khrod bsil ba'i gnas mchog nas/ /mkha' la rgyu ba'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /gcer bu nam mkha'i gos can ma/ /'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra yak+mo tra ga rak+ṣa ar+ghaṃ/ sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra yak+mo trag rak+ṣa i daṃ bha liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum gyis phul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis nang mchod phul/

rdo rje lha mo nam mkha'i gos can ma 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis chos sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi zhing / mthun rkyen yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i sdong grogs mdzad du gsol/ gtor ma byin brlabs dran pa gong bzhin/ mdun du hrīḥdamar po de las 'od zer 'phros dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las mgon po bse khrab can/ sku mdog pad+ma rwa ga'i phung po ltar dmar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs pa/ zhal bgrad cing / mche ba gtsigs pas gnod byed dgra bo'i srog dbugs skad cig la len pa/ phyag g.yas tsan+dan gyi bing chen klad la bskor bas sprul pa 'bum sde'i dmag tshogs 'dren pa/ g.yon zhags pa khra bo thugs kar bsnams pas bstan pa'i dgra bo'i tshe srog gcod pa/ dbu la bse'i rmog zhu dar dmar cod paṇa gyis mdzes pa gsol zhing / bse khrab khra bo sku la gsol ba/ dar ljang gu'i stod g.yogs dang dar dmar gyi 'jol ber khrab 'og tu gsol ba/ gdug pa can gyi snying rtsa gcod par byed pa'i ral gri dang / chos 'khor rgya chen srung ba'i stag dong thog ser gyi gang ba g.yas su 'khyil zhing / bdud bzhi 'joms par byed pa'i gzhu chu srin gyi mgo bo'i mchog ma can gzig shubs dang bcas pa g.yon na bsnam pa/ rlung gi shugs 'gros stong gsum yud kyis bskor ba'i rta mchog rag pa chibs su chibs shing / mtshal bu rting dkar rol du khrid pa/ me ri 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i g.yas su sku'i sprul pa ne'u gru bzhi'i klu btsan sku mdog mthing nag sku la ber nag dgu brtsegs gsol ba/ mthing nag dar gyi thod bcings byas pa/ lag la sbrul nag gi zhags pa thogs pa/ rta mchog bra nag la zhon pa/

sprul pa sbrul nag 'bum sde 'gyed pa'o/ /g.yon na gsung gi sprul pa btsan gyi rgyal po bse khrab can sku mdog dmar nag dar dmar ber chen sku la gsol ba/ phyag g.yas btsan zhags dmar po bsnams pa/ g.yon pa 'phan dar dmar po 'dzin pa/ chibs su btsan rta dmar po rol ba/ sprul pa sprel dmar pho nyar 'gyed pa'o/ /mdun na thugs kyi sprul pa steng phyogs lha'i srung ma sku mdog dkar po rin chen dar dkar sku la gsol zhing / g.yas pas zhags pa dkar po 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas rta mchog kha lo bsgyur ba/ lha rta dkar po'i steng na 'gying pa/ dge slong bzang po sprul par 'gyed pa'o/ /rje'i rgyal po rin po che shin tu mtshar ba'i skyes bu chen po ni/ za 'og dmar khra sku la gsol ba/ phyag g.yas sba lcags dkar po bsnams pa/ g.yon pa dung dkar 'brug stong ldir ba/ cang shes nag khra chibs su chibs/ dpa' bo stag chas sprul par 'gyed pa'o/ /rgyab tu yon tan gyi sprul pa chos gter gyi srung ma sku mdog dkar po/ dar dkar ras dkar sku la gsol ba/ leb rgan dar gyi 'dzum thod bcings pa/ g.yas pas zhags pa dkar po 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas sba lcags dkar po bsnams pa/ mtsha' lu rting dkar zhon par byas pa/ byi la gwa pa sprul par 'gyed pa'o/ /mtshams bzhir 'phrin las kyi sprul pa mgon po dmag chas can sku mdog dmar ser bse khrab khra bo sku la gsol ba/ dar gyi 'dzum thod sprin ltar 'thibs pa/ g.yas zhags pa dkar po klad la skor zhing / g.yon sba lcag dkar po bsnams pa/ rag pa rting dkar chibs su chibs pa/ sngags pa nag po pho nyar 'gyed pa thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sprul pa'i bstan srung chen po 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sngon tshe lo chen blo ldan shes rab kyis/ /bod yul bstan pa bsrung bar bka' bsgos pa'i/ /chos rgyal chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/

/spyan 'dren mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ hrīḥm hā rā dza ti i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ chos skyong chen po bse khrab can 'khor tshogs dregs byed pho nya dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi sdang bar byed pa'i dgra sod/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs thul/ bar du gcod par byed pa'i rkyen bzlog mthun rkyen yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang / ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du lam sgrub pa'i grogs zhu/ log 'tsho spangs te 'dod pa'i longs spyod chos ldan du 'byung ba'i phrin las stsol/ ༈ /mkha' 'gro'i spyi gtor byin brlabs dran pa gong ltar byas la/ lag pa'i mdzub mo gnyis lu gu rgyud du sbrel/ mthe bong gnyis dang gung mo gnyis so sor sbyar/ sor mo lhag ma rnams 'bar ba ltar byas pa dpral ba'i steng du g.yon du skor gdong 'gyur zhing mig gyen du blta ba dang bcas pas/ phaiṃḥ zhes dang / oṃ badz+ra a ra lī ho/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā kī hī sa ma ya staṃ tṛ sh+ya hoḥ zhes brjod de snying gi hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis 'dzam bu gling ni gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod brgyad mdun gyi nam mkhar byon pas bsams la/ de rnams la gtor ma phul bar bsams te/ thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa sa/ bhu ta/ pre ta pi sha tsi/ ud mā da/ a pa smra ra/ ḍā kā ḍā kī nā dā ya/ i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi/ me pra ya ts+tshan+tu/ ya thai baṃ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ dzi gha tha/ pi pa tha/ ma ti pra ma thā/ ma ma sarba kārta ya/ sad+mu khaṃ bi shud+dha ye/ sa hā yi ka bha wan+tu/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyi phul/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ pā d+yaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ sogs nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/

nang mchod phul te/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro la sogs pa gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /zhes sogs gong ltar brjod/ ༈ /gzhi bdag la gtor ma byin brlabs dran pa gong ltar byas la/ bhū ta sa pā ri wā ra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ a kā ro sogs gsum mam lngas phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ de nas nang mchod phul la/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi gtso byas 'dzam bu gling bzhi'i bdag po bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis/ sgos dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ bye brag tu sa phyogs dang yul phyogs 'di nyid la gnas pa'i/ lha/ klu/ btsan/ bdud/ sa bdag gnyan mthu bo che/ gzhi bdag gnas bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /'jig rten gyi khams su char chu dus su 'bab pa dang / lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa dang / mi nad dang / phyug nad dang / 'khrug pa thams cad mi 'byung zhing zhi ba'i 'phrin las dang sdong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ zhes phrin las gzhol/ ༈ bzlas pa ni sgrub pa po la dam sel byung ba dang / de'i rkyen gyis srung ma la grib phog nas mi 'dod pa sna tshogs byung na/ de bsal ba'i phyir 'khon gcugs sbyong ba'i tshul ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ mdun gyi mgon po la phogs pas/ mgon po'i thugs kar hūm̐ dkar po bsam/ de las 'od zer dang bdud rtsi dkar po dpag tu med pa byung / mgon po'i sku gang bas/ thugs ma mnyes pa dang / nyams sgrib dang / 'bags btsog thams cad sbyangs/ yang thugs ka nas 'od zer dkar po byung / bdag gam yon bdag sogs kyi spyi bor thim/ des lus kyi nang thams cad khengs pas sdig pa dang / sgrib pa dang / dam tshig nyams pa dang / dri ma thams cad sbyangs par bsams la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/

he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha ḍ-i dho me bha wa/ su toṣ+ya me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shrī yaṃḥ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñtsa he ru ko bha wa ma hā/ sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ gtso bor bzlas pa'i mthar/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dkar po byung ba rang ngam sbyin bdag gi spyi bor nas thim pas/ nyes pa dag par bsams pa ni/ 'khon gcugs sbyangs pa'i tshul yin/ srung ma gzhan rnams la'ang de bzhin bya'o/ /de nas rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer las dam rdzas dang mchod pa'i yo byad dpag tu med pa spros/ sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad bkang ste mchod pas/ chos skyong rnams mnyes/ sku lus 'od dang gzi brjid bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur te/ bdag la ji ltar 'dod pa'i dngos grub thams cad stsal bar bsam mo/ /bzlas pa dngos ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas tsha zhing rtsub pa mi stag lta bu'i 'od zer 'phros pas/ chos skyong 'khor bcas kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul nas phrin las gang bcol sgrub par bsam zhing / yungs dkar/ gu gul/ dug tshil chen rnams bsres pa'i bdug spos sreg cing / oṃ hrīḥpad+man sogs rta mgrin gyi sngags 'dogs med ci rigs dang / oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yi ge bdun pa dang / oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa'i yi ge bcu gnyis pa dang / shā sa na/ rnams ci nus bzlas/ oṃ ro ru/ sogs lha mo'i sngags dang / oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bī/ sogs nas/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐/ bar gyi zhal sngags dang / oṃ ro tu tri tsa/ sogs las mkhan mo dang / a li/ sogs pho'i bdo sngags/ nam mkha'i gos can ma'i sngags dang bse khrab la/ oṃ badz+ra tri du yak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes rgyal po spyi sngags rnams kyi rigs bzlas mthar/ oṃ shrī dharmā pā la sa pā ri wā ra grih+ṇa daṃ ar+ghaṃ swāhā/

sogs gong bzhin mtshan sngags de'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis nang mchod/ bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pas sangs rgyas gyi bstan pa dar ba dang / sogs gong bzhin/ bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa la zhu zhing gsol ba ni/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod grogs mched 'khor dang bcas pa rnams las dang nyon mongs pa dang / mi shes pa dang / ma gus pa dang / bag med pa dang / snyom las kyi dbang du gyur pas/ rang bzhin dang bcas pas kha nas ma tho ba bgyis pa dang / dam tshig dang mi ldan pa dang / dam tshig ma dag pa dang / tshogs 'dres pa dang / spyod yul gcig tu gyur pa dang / bsnyen pa dang / sgrub pa la ma brtson pa dang / srung ma khyad par can khyed rnams dus dus su ma mchod cing / ma gsol ba'i dbang gis sku gsung thugs kyis dam tshig nyams chags su gyur pa dang / khyed rnams kyi thugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa ci mchis pa de dag thams cad spros med rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang nas thugs rje dang / mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal mgon khyad par can khyed rnams kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so/ /bzod par gsol lo/ /mkha' la sprin dengs pa'am/ rgya mtsho la rlabs zhi ba ltar/ nongs pa spyad pa dang / de'i 'bras bu thams cad med par gyur cig zhi bar gyur cig rab tu zhi bar gyur cig sngags dang / phyag rgya dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'di dang / rta mchog rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'di dang / tshogs kyi 'khor lo dam pa dang bcas pa'i mchod pa 'dis/ dpal mgon khyad par can khyed rnams kyi thugs dam skong bar gyur cig bzhed pa 'grub par gyur cig re ba rdzogs par gyur cig de ltar gyur nas kyang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod grogs mched 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang / 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i nad dang gdon dang rims dang bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/

dgra dang bgegs dang log par 'dren pa bzlog tu gsol/ tshe dang dpal dang 'byor pa dang dbang phyug phun sum tshogs par mdzad du gsol/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod pa'i mthar/ khyed thugs gsang ba dam pa'i mdzod/ /dges pa chen po'i sgo phye nas/ /dngos grub phrin las bdud rtsi yi/ /rgyun gyis bdag rgyud gtams par mdzod/ /lan gsum/ bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pas sku'i dam tshigs nyams pa dang / gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa dang / thugs kyi dam tshigs nyams pa mthol lo bshags so/ /bzod par gsol lo/ /tshangs par stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ chos skyong rgyal po chen po rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams la zhu zhing gsol ba ni/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor yon mchod grogs mched 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa 'khrugs pa las byung ba'i/ 'bras bu bdag 'dzin gyi phung po rnam par shes pa dang bcas pa rnams nas/ mi shes ma gus bag med pa las byung ba'i mi dge ba bcu/ mtshams med pa lnga/ de dang nyes pa lnga/ sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba'i nyes ltung / mtho ris dang thar pa byang chub sgrub pa'i gegs su gyur cing / 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyur gyur pa thams cad chos skyong chen po khyed kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so/ /khyad par du yang bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa'i spyan sngar bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i zab mo'i man ngag rgya mtsho rnams nos nas bsnyen sgrub mchod gtor sogs dam tshig bsrung zhing 'dzin par khas blangs kyang / bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod grogs mched 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mi dge nyon mongs la goms pa'i dbang gis dam nyams sdig can la ngo dga' yid 'jog gis lhan cig tu gnas nas gsang ba khrom bsgrags su gyur pa dang / snyom las kyi dbang gis bsnyen sgrub mchod gtor la mi brtson pa dang /

le lo'i dbang gis drug ldan rten gyi tshogs ma bshams pa dang / ser sna dang 'dod srid kyi dbang gis mchod gtor ngan cing rang gis bza' btung bzang po bag med du zos pa dang / zhe sdang ngan sems kyi dbang gis 'phrin las zhu bar mi 'os pa zhus pa dang / gti mug phrag dog gi dbang gis rang la bsrung skyob mdzad pa mi shes shing / gzhan phrin las mdzad 'os rnams la mdzad pa la rang bzhin dang bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba bgyis pa dang / dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs kyang sems can rnams dang rigs 'gre sbyar ba'i kha zhe mi mtshungs pa bgyis pa sogs mdor na bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod grogs mched 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyis steng na sdig ltung nyes pa'i tshogs ci mchis pa de dag thams cad srung ma khyad par can khyed rnams kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so/ /mi 'chab bo/ /mi sbed do/ /slan chad kyang bsdam par bgyi'o/ /nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad mthu nus kyi rlung gis gtor cig ye shes kyi mes sregs shig thugs rje'i chab kyis khrus shig byin rlabs gzi 'od kyis non cig de ltar du gyur nas bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod grogs mched 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi nas legs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas te gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phun tshogs dpal 'byor dge legs ma lus pa rgyun mi 'chad pa stsal du gsol/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan srung dam can la/ /sdig ltung ci mchis 'gyod bshags phul ba'i mthus/ /las nyon bag chags dri ma kun zhi nas/ /gnas skabs mthar thug re smon yongs rdzogs shog ༈ /bskang rdzas rnams kyi dkyil du raṃ yaṃ/ de las me 'bar bas 'bags pa dang / ma dag pa'i skyon thams cad sreg par bsam la/ sngags dang phyag drug gis byin brlabs cha gsum 'bring po ltar mdzad pa las/

lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong gis mthe'u chung mnan/ lhag ma brkyangs ba gtor ma la gtad de/ oṃ swā bhā wa/ bi shūd+dhāḥ sarba dharmā/ te badz+ra sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes pas ma dag pa sbyangs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyis phyag rgya bcas la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥ bi shwa mu khaṃ bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ mang por spel/ lag pa gnyis sor mo rnams bsnol gung mo gnyis rtse sprad pa'i tshigs bar ba bcag pa dpral bar bcings te se gol gtogs/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bdud rtsir bsgyur/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya bcas/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ/ a d+ya nut+pan+na twat+ta ces pas mgron rnams kyi 'dod pa sgrub/ g.yas khro bo'i khu tshur bcang srin mdzub rdzas la gtad cing / dkrol la se gol gtogs/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ sam+bha ra sa m+bha ra hūm̐/ zhes pas so sor thob par bsam/ g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ni sarba ar+tha sa dha ni swāhā/ dus dang yo byad mnyam por thob par bsams la/ sngags rnams lan gsum re bya'o/ /bdag gis bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs pa/ /thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /ces bden stobs brjod/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya sa pā ri wā ra/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te/ sogs dang / shā sa na/ lha mo'i gtor sngags/ de bzhin zhal nas las mkhan gyi gtor sngags bar/ gong bzlas pa'i mjug bzhin phyi nang gi mchod pa 'dod gsol bcas byas la/ de nas dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ med kyang rung ste/ ༈ /hūm̐ he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /rnam 'phrul bye ba mtha' yas pas/ /dgra bgegs rdul bzhin brlag mdzad pa/ /mthu chen dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskang /

/hūm̐ dpal ldan mgon po khyod kyi sku/ /dus mtha'i sprin ltar ches gnag cing / /nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can/ /dpa' bo gar gyi nyams dgu ldan/ /de 'dra'i sku yi ting 'dzin mchog /rab tu gsal bar bsgoms pa dang / /bsten zhing rgyun du mchod pa yis/ /dpal mgon sku yi thugs dam bskang / /sna tshogs rin chen las grub pa'i/ /dbu rgyan mgul rgyan snyan cha dang / /dpung rgyan lag gdub do shal dang / /rkang gdub sor gdub rin chen rgyan/ /klu chen brgyad kyi sbrul rgyan dang / /rab mdzes dar gyi lhab lhub dang / /stag lpags sham thabs la sogs pas/ /ma hā kā la'i thugs dam bskang / /mi rus mchog las grub pa yi/ /'khor lo rna cha mgul rgyan dang / /lag gdub dang ni ska rags sogs/ rus rgyan drug gi rgyan cha dang / /thod skam lnga yi cod paṇa dang / /gdug pa can gyi mgo bo'i phreng / /khrag 'dzag lnga bcu'i do shal gyis/ /ma hā kā la'i༞ /rab mdzes rgyan gyi bye brag rnams/ /nag po chen po 'khor bcas kyi /sku la mchod pa phul ba yis/ /sku yi dam tshig nyams chags bskang / /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad dang gdon gyi gnod pa sogs/ /lus kyi bar chad zhi ba dang / /tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par mdzod/ ༈ hūm̐ nag po chen po khyed kyi gsung / /bzhad sgra sngags kyi nga ro yi/ /'brug stong 'khrugs pa zil gnon zhing / /bdud dang log 'dren snying rab 'gem/ /de 'dra'i gsung gi rnal 'byor ni/ /rab tu gsal bar bsgoms pa dang / /dran dang rgyun du bsten pa yis/ /dpal mgon gsung gi thugs dam bskang / /rtsa sngags snying po nye snying sogs/ /drag po'i gsang sngags zab mo rnams/ /dngos grub thams cad bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /dag cing gsal bar bzlas pa dang / /mgon po 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi/ /bsnyen sgrub tshad du bskyal ba dang / /zab mo'i bzlas brjod rnam mang gis/ /ma hā kā la'i༞ /gzhan yang bstod dbyangs snyan pa yis/

/bstod tshig zab mo dpag med rnams/ /snyan cing brjid pas bstod pa dang / /bde gshegs gsung rab bsgrags pa dang / /rnga chen dung dang cha lang dang / /cang te'u 'khar rnga dril bu dang / /pi wang la sogs sgra snyan gyis/ /ma hā kā la'i༞ /sna tshogs rol mo'i bye brag rnams/ nag po chen po༞ /gsung la༞ gsung ge༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /gzhan gyi ngag mnan byas pa sogs/ /ngag gi bar chad zhi ba dang / /snyan grags phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzod/ /hūm̐ nag po chen po khyed kyi thugs/ /zag med yon tan kun ldan zhing / /chos dbyings shin tu rnam dag la/ /spang bya'i dri ma kun dang bral/ /de 'dra'i thugs kyi yon tan ni/ /rab tu dad pas bsgoms pa dang / /bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin sgrub pa yis/ /dpal mgon thugs kyi thugs dam༞ /gri lcags chen po las grub pa'i/ /dam tshig rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /rdo rje gri gug 'bar ba dang / /thod khrag rnam 'phrul gaṇ+ḍi dang / /sna tshogs rin chen las grub pa'i/ /'khor lo rin chen pad+ma dang / /rdo rje rgya gram la sogs pas/ /ma hā kā la'i༞ /gser dngul byu ru mu tig dang / /mu men in+t+ra ni la sogs/ /yid 'ong rin chen bsam yas dang / /dar chen kha dog sna tshogs dang / /ri mo sna tshogs rab bkra ba'i/ /zab chen kha dog du ma dang / /gos chen gser gyi rgyan ldan pas/ /ma hā kā la'i༞ /sna tshogs mchod pa'i yo byad rnams/ /nag po chen po 'khor bcas kyi/ /thugs la༞ /thugs kyi༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /smyo 'bog sems 'khrugs la sogs pa/ /sems kyi bar chad༞ /bsam don chos bzhin rgyas par mdzod/ /hūm̐ yon tan dpag yas mgon po khyod/ /stobs bcu mi 'jigs rnam bzhi dang / /ma 'dres dran pa nyer gzhag sogs/ /bsam yas yon tan kun dang ldan/ /de lta'i mgon po'i yon tan ni/ /dran zhing dad pa bskyed pa dang / /dam chos tshul bzhin bzung ba yis/ /dpal mgon yon tan༞ /mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog dang /

/bdug spos snang gsal dri mchog dang / /zhal zas sil snyan la sogs pa/ /nye bar spyod pa thams cad dang / /gzugs sgra la sogs 'dod yon lnga/ /dri lnga sman lnga 'bru sna lnga/ /snying po lnga sogs mchod rdzas kyis/ /ma hā kā la'i༞ /gzhan yang khyad 'phags rin chen bdun/ /lha mi'i yo byad bkra shis brgyad/ /gser gyi gdugs mdzes tog can dang / /yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal mtshan dang / /rnga yab dngul gyi yu ba can/ /'phan dang ba dan lda ldi dang / /bla bre la sogs rgyan rnams kyis/ /ma hā kā la'i༞ /yid 'ong 'dod yon du ma rnams/ /nag po chen po༞ /yon tan mchog la mchod pa yis/ /yon tan༞ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /gzhan gyi byad kha phur kha sogs/ /yon tan bar chad zhi ba dang / /sbyin sogs yon tan rgyas par mdzod/ ༈ /gong sku gsung thugs sogs bzhi la rdum byang dpyad/ 'phrin las lhun grub mgon po khyod/ /rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje las/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir khyod sprul nas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrungs bar mdzad/ /de lta'i mgon po'i phrin las ni/ /dran dang las la bskul ba dang / /bde gshegs phrin las bskyangs pa yis/ /dpal mgon phrin las༞ /ral gri rtse gsum mdung thung dang / /spu gri gseg shang chu gri dang / /phag mdung thag mdung mdung ring dang / /wa mda' dkyus mda' mda' bo che/ /gzhu dang phur bu dam shing dang / /dgra satwa gtun shing lcags kyu dang / /dbyug pa satwa re la sogs pas/ /ma hā kā la'i༞ /rta mchog nag po rdzu 'phrul shugs/ /seng chen 'gying 'dra rlung ltar mgyogs/ /gser sga dngul srab g.yu yi mthur/ /gser ldan dar thag brgyan pa sogs/ /yid 'ong rta mchog mang po dang / /drel nag 'phar ba dgu chod dang / /srin po'i bong bu gwa dmar gyis/ /ma hā kā la'i༞ /g.yag rgod rog po mdangs ldan dang / /bdud lug nag po spyi dkar dang / /spu sdug mdzes pa'i bya nag dang / /khyi nag snying dkar la sogs pa/

/dud 'gro rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /seṅge stag gzig dom la sogs/ /gcan gzan rnam pa mang po yi/ /ma hā kā la'i༞ /khyung dang khu byug ne tso dang / /rma bya ngang pa ngur pa dang / /shang shang te'u la sogs pa/ /'dab chags sna tshogs dkor nor ni/ /mchod 'os gzugs mdzes ci mchis pa/ /yan lag dbang po yongs rdzogs shing / /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa 'dis/ /ma hā kā la'i༞ /ri mo rab bkra stag lpags dang / /thig le rab bkod gzig dang gung / /spu sdug gra bzang dom dang dred/ /spu zhag mdog legs sram la sogs/ /gcan gzan pags pa sna tshogs dang / /khrab rmog ber chen phub la sogs/ /go cha sna tshogs rab btsan pas/ /ma hā kā la'i༞ /rdzas dang yo byad sna tshogs rnams/ /nag po chen po 'khor bcas kyi/ phrin las mchog la mchod pa yis/ /phrin las dam tshig nyams chags bskang / /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /dgra dang chom rkum gnod pa sogs/ /phrin las bar chad zhi ba dang / /gzhan don chos bzhin rgyas par mdzod/ ༈ /hūm̐ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /thun mong ma yin mchod pa'i rdzas/ /bdud rtsir byin brlabs bdud rtsi lngas/ /ma hā kā la'i༞ /thabs kyi yo byad lcags kyu lnga/ /shes rab mchod pa 'bru bcud chang / /ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs pas/ /ma hā kā la'i༞ /mtshan ldan ye shes ka pā lar/ dam rdzas dzam+bu ṭi ka sogs/ /kha zas bzang dgus rab bkang bas/ /ma hā kā la'i༞ /bza' dang bca' ba yang dag ldan/ /kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa/ /rab mdzes rgyan gyis rnam brgyan nas/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas rgya cher spel/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i gtor ma 'dis/ /ma hā kā la'i༞ /dpal ldan mgon po'i༞ /bstan srung chen po'i thugs dam bskang / /hūm̐ sprul pa'i khyung chen bya nag tshogs/ /lce spyang mi nag khyi nag dang / /khro chung pho nya yang sprul rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor mas thugs dam bskang / /yum chen e ka dza ṭī dang / /lha mo 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/

/ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor mas༞ /nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa/ /sring bzhi dregs pa'i tshogs bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin༞ /dam can gnod sbyin yab yum dang / /bka' bsdod pu tra ming sring dang / /ru 'dren sde bzhi 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin༞ /dur khrod bdag po phyogs skyong dang / /zhing skyong lha srin sde brgyad dang / /dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud kun/ /mchod sbyin gtor mas thugs dam bskang / /gtor ma gsol zhing btung ba dang / /bzhes shing bsnams par mdzad nas kyang / /'gro la zhi rgyas bsrung skyobs rnams/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bzhin mdzod/ /ces pa'i bar bya'o/ /de nas bzlog pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐ lha chen dpal 'bar mthu ma chung / /ma mo mkha' 'gro bang ma bul/ /pho nya las mkhan rtsal ma zhan/ /rbad dus dam can mthu ma chung / /dpal 'bar ma hā kā la ni/ /khram kha sgyur ba'i mthu bo che/ /bdud kha sgyur ba'i nga ro can/ /do nub bzlog sgyur dus la babs/ /srid pa'i khram kha da sgyur cig /lha 'dre'i dmag sna dgra la drongs/ /gzhan gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa dang / /byad kha phur kha gtong ba bzlog /'tshe zor yungs zor 'phen pa bzlog /'byung po'i thod zor 'phan pa bzlog /gshin rje'i 'khor lo bskor ba bzlog /bdud kyi khram kha gtod pa bzlog /ma mo'i khrag zor 'phen pa bzlog /klu yi byad du bcug pa bzlog /the'u rang sri la rku ba bzlog /mu stegs bar chad byed pa bzlog /rgyal po'i smyo 'bog gtong ba bzlog /ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi bzlog /ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu bzlog /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ltas ngan/ /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi bzlog /lo keg zla keg zhag keg bzlog /drang srong gza' yi ki kang bzlog /zhang zhung gtso dmar 'phen pa bzlog /sum pas glang zor 'phen pa bzlog /ban+dhes sngags zor 'phen pa bzlog /bon pos gtad zor 'phen pa bzlog

/skyes pas mda' zor 'phen pa bzlog /bud med dmod zor dmod pa bzlog /rlung gi gshed bzhis 'ching ba dang / mo rtsis ngan pa thams cad bzlog /mkha' 'gro ma dang ro langs dang / /rgyal srin bar chad byed pa bzlog /de la sogs te gdug sems rnams/ /thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /thams cad rbod gtong steng du bh+yoḥ /ma hā kā la mthu bo che/ /phrin las drag po mi bzad pas/ /sod cig thul cig dgra dang bgegs/ /gtad do gnyer ro thugs dam can/ /rtags dang mtshan pa myur du phyung / /le lo g.yel ba ma mdzad par/ /bdag gi dpung dang grogs mdzod cig /bdag gi 'khor dang longs spyod kun/ /rtag tu bsrung skyobs gnyer dam mdzod/ ༈ /bstod pa ni/ so so'i sngags dang dbyangs dang bcas pa bstod pa'i sde tshan dgra las rnam rgyal sogs dang bstod tshig rab 'bar ma byed tshe/ ༈ oṃ swasti/ bla ma dang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// hūm̐/ rab 'bar bskal pa'i me dpung klong dkyil na/ /rab brjid gzugs thung mdog nag cher 'bar zhing / /rab gsal spyan gsum me stag lta bur 'phro/ /rab gdangs zhal dmar rnam par g.yo la bstod/ /shin tu rgyas pa'i phyag gnyis thugs khar ni/ /gri gug thod khrag rnam 'phrul gaṇ+ḍe bsnams/ /zlum po'i stabs kyis zhabs gnyis dgra bgegs kyi/ /snying khar brdabs pas sa gsum g.yo la 'dud/ /rab mdzes rin chen dar gyis cod paṇa bklubs/ /mi sdug sbrul dang rul pa'i rgyan cha 'khrol/ /'jigs rung khrag 'dzag mgo bo'i do shal can/ /dpa' bo stag gi sham thabs can la 'dud/ /rigs lnga'i ngo bo khyung chen nam mkhar 'phyo/ /bya nag gshog skor khyi nag 'khang zhing zug /ce spyang 'bros 'dod mi nag bshug glu len/ /sprul pa'i pho nyas dgra bgegs sgrol la 'dus/ /ha ha 'dod khro rmongs pa'i grong khyer sgyel/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ gzung 'dzin rtog pa'i brag ri bshig /phaṭa phaṭa bdud dang dgra bgegs snying rab 'gems/

/srid gsum skrag mdzad drag po'i gsung la 'dud/ /spros kun nyer zhi'i chos sku mngon gyur kyang / /gdug can zhi bas 'dul bar ma nus pa/ /rnam 'phrul drag pos 'dul ba'i thabs mkhyen nas/ /tshar gcod rjes 'dzin mnga' ba'i thugs la 'dud/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gcig dpal ldan ma/ spyan gsum ldan pas zhal gcig mche ba gtsigs/ /khams gsum zil gnon ral gcig g.yon du 'phyang / /srid gsum g.yo mdzad yum gcig ma la 'dud/ /'dod khams zil gnon 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ /mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor/ /khrag gi mtshor gnas khrag gi thig les brgyan/ /'jigs pa'i mtshon chas 'jigs rung ma la 'dud/ /hūm̐ zhal bzhi phrin las bzhi yis 'gro ba skyong / /mche ba bzhi yis bdud bzhi rnam par 'joms/ /phyag bzhi'i sna tshogs mtshon chas rgyud bzhi srung / /sring mo bzhi ldan gdong bzhi pa la 'dud/ /hūm̐ gnod sbyin yab yum bdud kyi mgo bo gcod/ /bka' bsdod pu tras dgra bo'i klad khrag 'dren/ /'jigs byed bha ṭas dgra snying spar gyis 'debs/ /bstan dgra sreg byed kha 'bar ma la 'dud/ /mgon po'i bka' nyan las mkhan ma rungs pa/ /bud med skyes pa dge slong sngags pa'i gzugs/ /brgya phrag bzhi yis phyogs bzhi'i ru 'dren pa/ /sprul pa'i dmag tshogs rnams la bstod par bgyi/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang thugs kyi ye shes las/ /bka' bsdod srung ma'i tshul du rnam sprul nas/ /bstan pa rin chen bang mdzod legs skyong ba'i/ /dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas spel ba'i gtor ma dang / /dam rdzas spyan gzigs mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' bsgos ltar/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la/ /nad dang gdon dang gzhan gyi byad ka sogs/ /dam chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen kun zhi nas/ /tshe dang bsod nams 'khor dang longs spyod sogs/

/mthun rkyen ma lus phun sum tshogs par mdzod/ /bstan 'dzin thams cad sku tshe brtan pa dang / /bstan pa rin chen phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang / /bstan la gnod byed dgra bgegs 'dul ba dang / /bstan pas khyab pa'i 'gro rnams bde bar mdzod/ /grong khyer sum brtsegs thub bstan grong khyer skyong / /'jigs rung zhal gdangs 'jigs rung gad rgyang sgrog /dpung chen nus mthus bdud kyi dpung chen 'joms/ /bstan srung khyod kyis bstan pa 'di skyongs shig ༈ /bstan 'dzin rnams kyi sku tshe bsring ba dang / /bstan la gnod byed ma rungs skye bo rnams/ /drag po mngon spyod las kyis tshar bcad nas/ /bstan pa yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas par mdzod/ /nam mkha'i gos can mar bskang gso yod na 'dir bya'o// ༈ /bkra shis lha yi gzhas yas nas/ /rgyal po'i sku gcig spyan 'dren no/ /rgyal po de ni bse khrab can/ /spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /sngon kyi bskal pa dang po la/ /'gar ston shi ri raka sha dang / /chos grags bde ba'i mchog 'bum gyis/ /gtsug lag khang gcig bzhengs par 'tshal/ /de yi srung mar khas blangs pa'i/ /rgyal po de ni bse khrab can/ /khyed kyi sku la ci gsol na/ /bse khrab de ni khra bo gsol/ /dbu la de ni ci gsol na/ /dbu la bse yi rmog zhu gsol/ /khyed kyi chibs su ci chibs na/ /rag pa de ni rting dkar chibs/ /sku yi rol du ci khrid na/ /mtsha' lu rting dkar rol du khrid/ /khyed kyi phyag ni g.yas pa na/ /tsan+dan bing chen zings se zing / /khyed kyi phyag ni g.yon pa na/ /zhags pa khra bo khyugs se khyugs/ /ma thogs de ni myur du byon/ /rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor phrin las myur du sgrubs/ 'gre'o/ /khyed kyis sprul pa 'gyed tsa na/ /res 'ga' ban+de nag por brdzu/ /sku la ber nag na bza' gsol/ /dbu la de ni rmog zhu gsol/ /phyag na gsil byed sreg shing bsnams/

/ban+de de ni mthu bo che/ /nag po chen po mthu bo che/ /ma thogs de ni myur du byon/ ༞༞ /res 'ga' sprul pa'i dus tsa na/ /ban+de de ni nag po la/ /ral pa'i thor lcog lcang lo 'khyil/ /phyag na tsan+dan bing chen bsnams/ ma thogs༞ ༞༞ /mched 'ga' sprul pa'i dus tsa na/ /bse khrab khra bo sku la gsol/ /dbu la dar gyi 'dzum thod bcing / /phyags g.yas zhags pa dkar po bsnams/ /g.yon pa sba lcag dkar po bsnams/ /khyed kyi chibs su ci chibs na/ /rag pa de ni rting dkar chibs/ /sku yi rol du ci khrid na/ /mtsha' lu rting dkar rol du khrid/ /ma thogs༞ ༞༞ /gsol yang de ni khyed gsol lo/ /mchod kyang de ni khyed mchod do/ /'bod dam de ni khyed 'bod na/ /'bod kyang de ni khyed 'bod do/ /brten nam de ni khyed brten na/ /brten yang de ni khyed brten no/ /rgyal po chen po khyed kyis ni/ /bdag la gnod pa'i dgra byung na/ /rgyal po chen po bse khrab can/ /bse yi de ni bdud sdoms la/ /rag pa rting dkar lcag brob la/ /zhags pa de ni phyag gsol la/ /ma thogs༞ ༞༞ /mched 'ga' sprul pa'i dus tsa na/ /mi dkar de ni rta dkar can/ /zhags pa dkar po phyag na bsnams/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis khyed bsgrub kyi/ /ma thogs༞ ༞༞ /res 'ga' sprul pa'i dus tsa na/ /mi pho shin tu mtshar ba la/ /sku la de ni ci gsol na/ /za 'og dmar khra'i slog pa gsol/ /phyag na de ni ci bsnams na/ /g.yas na sba lcag dkar po bsnams/ /g.yon na 'bud dung tse re re/ /khyed kyis chibs su ci chibs na/ /bra bo rting dkar chibs su chibs/ /rje yi rgyal po rin po che/ /bdag la gnod pa'i dgra byung na/ /ma thogs༞ ༞༞ /bra bo rting dkar lcag brob la/ /'bud dung 'bud cing tshul byon cig /g.yon na srung ma 'khor dang bcas/ /'khor bcas de ni ma lus kun/ /'bud dung sgra yis mtshon nas kyang / /srung ma gcig gis gcig bskul nas/

/dam nyams dgra la dmag 'dren 'tshal/ /bdun rgyud rtsad nas bcad 'tshal lo/ /pho rgyud rtsad nas bcad 'tshal lo/ /mo rgyud rtsad nas bcad 'tshal lo/ /cho 'phrul da lta bstan 'tshal lo/ /ltas ngan sna tshogs bstan 'tshal lo/ /sba lcag dkar po ldems se ldem/ /dung sgra de ni ldi ri ri/ /ma thogs༞ ༞༞ /ma g.yel ma g.yel thugs dam can/ /rbad cing mngags pa'i dgra bo la/ /sbos nad glang thabs rgyal nad thongs/ /kha nad snying nad gzer nad thongs/ /snying khrag dron mor da rol cig /res 'ga' brdzu zhing rol tsa na/ /sku la bse khrab khra bo gsol/ /dbu la bse yi rmog zhu gsol/ /rgyab na bse phub khra bo khur/ /phyag na bse mdung dmar po bsnams/ /ba dan dmar po sgo ro ro/ /'phur lce dmar po lhabs se lhab/ /klad na bse yi khyung chen lding / /ru mtshon sprin ltar thibs se thib/ /rgyal po chen po bse khrab can/ /dus la babs so rgyal po pa/ /bdag la gnod pa'i dgra byung na/ /srung ma khyed kyis ra mda' bzlog /dpung gnyen mdzod cig bse khrab can/ /dus la babs so rgyal po pa/ /phrin las mdzod cig sprul pa'i tshogs/ /yang yang de ni sprul pa'i tshogs/ /sku la de ni ci gsol na/ /dar dkar de ni ras dkar gsol/ /le brgan de ni 'dzum thod can/ /khyed kyi phyag ni g.yas pa na/ /zhags pa dkar po khyug se khyug /khyed kyi phyag ni g.yon pa na/ /sba lcag dkar po ldems se sdems/ /chibs su de ni ci chibs na/ /mtsha' lu rting dkar chibs su chibs/ /dpung gnyen mdzod cig bse khrab can/ /phrin las mdzod cig sprul pa'i tshogs/ /btsan rgyal chen po'i sprul pa ni/ /byi la de ni gwa bar brdzu/ /res 'ga' sprul pa'i dus tsa na/ ban+de de ni spre'u brdzu/ /sdang pa'i dgra la rbad tsa na/ /dmag dpon chen po'i chas su zhugs/ /res 'ga' sprul pa'i dus tsa na/ /ban+de de ni bzang por sprul/ /rgyal po chen po bse khrab can/ /'khor du klu dang btsan gyis bskor/

/bdag gi mthu dang dpung la byon/ ༈ /hūm̐ btsan gyi rgyal po bse khrab can/ /sku la de ni ci gsol na/ /btsan ber dmar po sku la gsol/ /dbu la bse rgan 'dzum thod bcings/ /khyed kyis chibs su ci chibs na/ /btsan rta dmar po chibs su chibs/ /g.yas na btsan zhags dmar po bsnams/ /bstan srung rgyal po 'khor dang bcas/ /phrin las mdzod cig rgyal po pa/ /ne'u gru bzhi'i klu btsan ni/ /sku la ber nag na bza' gsol/ /dbu la mthing nag thod can bcings/ /chibs su rta nag bra bo chibs/ /lag na sbrul gyi zhags pa thogs/ /sprul pa yang dag stong du sprul/ /lcags kyi sdig pa khro lo lo/ /zangs kyi sbal nag chi li li/ /g.yu yi ljang mo nyi li li/ /khyed kyi thugs rje'i dus la babs/ /dus la babs so da tshur byon/ /rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor phrin las myur du sgrubs/ ༈ (/'di nas shog grangs kha shas mi tshang /)gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas kyis/ /dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ zhes sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i bar dang / /de'i rjes su/ kol+la'i rer gnas rdo rje dang kol+la e re ṭ+yi a bo lā mum+bu ṇi ri ka k+ko lā/ mum+bu ṇir pad+ma'o/ gha ṇe kṛ pi ṭa ho bādz+dza i ho tshogs su cong te'u dkrol/ ka ru ṇi ki a i ni ro lā/ snying rjes ku co yi bya'o/ /ta heṃ ba la khādz+dza i/ de ru sha ni bza' bar bya/ ga ḍheṃ ma a ṇa pidz+dza i/ 'bad pas chang ni btung bar bya/ ha lo kā lañdza ra pa ṇi a i/ ho ha la gdan bzhugs par bya/ dan+tu ra badz+dza a le tsa u sa ma kats+tshur pin lā /skal med rnams ni spang bar bya/ kap+pu ra lā i a i/ ga bur rnams ni byug par bya/ mā la in+dha ṇa pā liñdza/ tshod ma dang ni sha chen no/

ta hiṃ bha ru khā i a i/ de ni mang du bza' bar bya/ phreṃ kha ṇa kha ṭa ka ran+te/ 'ong ba dang ni 'gro bar bya/ shud+dha a shud+dha na mu ni/ dag dang ma dag dmigs mi bya/ a i/ ni ri su aṃ ge tsa ṭa wi/ rus pa'i rgyan ni lus la gdags/ ta hiṃ dza sa rā wa pa ṇi a i/ der ni skyes pa'i ro gzhug bya/ ma la a dze ku na du ru nā ṭa i/ sar gri gang la 'jug par bya/ ḍaṇ+ṭi ma ta hiṇ+ṇa badz+dzi a i/ der ni reg min yang mi bya/ zhes rdo rje'i glu dbyangs/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i kra shis dang po yin/ /de yis nye bar brten pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mi mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa yin/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pas bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyis mchod byed cing / /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa yin/ /zhes bkra shis brjod/ rigs su skyes dang dam tshig can/ /smyo med kye yi rdo rje ston/ /bla ma la gus snying rje ldan/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol/ /zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang / /btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par/ /gang gi lam gyi grol 'gyur ba/ /de yi sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces smon lam btab/ hūm̐ dpal ldan mgon po ma hā kā la dang / /dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /lcam dral khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i/

/dur khrod bdag po zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud༞ /mkha' lding bya khyi lcags spyang༞ /pu tra la sogs las mkhan༞ /srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma༞ /dzaṃ bu ṭi ba'i zhal zas༞ /chang dang phud kyi mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /sngags bcol las kyi gtang rag gnyen po 'bul/ /da bcol las kyi gsol 'debs gnyen po bzhes/ /'khor rnams bsrung zhing rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang / /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams mang po/ /thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i las 'di myur du sgrubs/ /zhes brjod la/ shā sa na/ bzla zhing gtor ma sa gtsang sar btang / kyai rnam dkar thugs bskyed bzang po'i rjes 'gro ltar/ /rnam mang phyi nang gsang gsum mchod sprin 'di/ /rnam dag ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin brlabs nas/ /rnam sprul dpag med srung ma 'khor bcas mchod/ /gsol lo mchod do rgyal chen rigs lnga mchod/ /sangs rgyas bstan srung dbang po 'khor bcas mchod/ /chos 'khor yongs kyi srung ma༞ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i dpung gnyen༞ /skye 'gro'i bde skyed 'byung gnas༞ /snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpon༞ /byang phyogs gangs can yul lha༞ /'dod dgu 'byung ba'i zhal zas lhun pos mchod/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i btung ba rgya mtshos mchod/ /dkor nor spyan gzigs nam mkha'i mdzod kyis mchod/ /skye 'gro'i snyan ngag rgya mtsho'i sprin gyis mchod/ /rol sil rnga chen stong gsum 'brug sgras mchod/ /mdzes pa'i rnam 'gyur yid 'dzin rgya mtshos mchod/ /'dod yon dpag med zad mi shes pas mchod/ /sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag gnyen por 'bul/ /da bcol legs pa'i gsol 'debs chen por bzhes/

/rgyal ba'i bstan pa yongs rdzogs khyod kyis srungs/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang khyod kyis bstod/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i phrin las khyod kyis sgrubs/ /'jig rten khams dang khyad par bod yul 'dir/ /nad dang 'khrug pa mu ge ma gtang zhig /mi shis ltas ngan cho 'phrul ma gtang zhig /skye dgu kun gyi nyon mongs khyed kyis sel/ /char chu phebs shing lo phyugs phun sum tshogs/ /tshe ring nad med bde skyed ldan la sogs/ /'gro kun re ba ma lus khyed kyis skongs/ /bdag cag yon mchod bsam don khyod kyis sgrubs/ /zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs logs 'dren kun/ /rgyal chen 'khor bcas zhal du kha raṃ khā hi/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i las 'di khyod kyis sgrubs/ /bla mas bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang / /de 'dzin byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa kun/ /dpal 'byor gyis brgyan yun ring zhabs brtan mdzod/ ༈ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la/ /tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /don rnams thams cad yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan par mdzod/ /dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs dang / /dkon mchog yi dam rgya mtsho'i bden pa dang / /mthu ldan chos skyong srung ma'i gzi 'od kyis/ /gnas mchog 'dir yang bkra shis deng 'dir stsol/ /oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa mā ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ d+dho me bha wa su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo mi bha wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shrī yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñtsa he ru ko bha wa/ ma hā sa mā ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ tshar gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyid pa dang ni bgyis stsal ba/
