/de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /gang yang bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas sems bying ba dang / rgod pa dang / sngags ma dag pa dang cho ga lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nongs pa'i tshogs ci mchis pa de dag thams cad bzod par mdzad nas bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la sgrib pa mi 'byung zhing lhag chad kha skong bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes lhag chad kha bskang zhing nongs pa bzod par gsol/ gtor mgron gyi rten yod pa rnams la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa rnams ji srid 'byung ba chen po sa chu me rlung gi gnod pas ma bshig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ /oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing nas la sogs pa rten rnams la gtor/ gtor mgron gyi rten med pa rnams la/ rten la ma brten pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badz+ra muḥ gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ mgon po lha brgyad dang zhal gyi rten med na gshegs mi rung bas/ gsang rten byed kyin yod na de la dang / med na/ mdun gyi mgon po lha brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa dang / zhing skyong dbang phyug zhal bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim/

zhes brjod pa man ngag dam pa yin no/ /rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rta mchog rol pa 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yis sa la 'god par shog /dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i/ /lus can kun gyi bsod nams ye shes tshogs/ /myur du 'grub nas tshe 'di kho na la/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la 'god par shog /bdag gi dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /bla med theg pa chen po'i snod gyur nas/ /kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /bdag kyang sangs rgyas ma thob bar/ /skye dang skye bar gnas bzang por/ /rigs bzang spyod pa bzang ba dang / /grogs bzang bla mas rjes 'dzin shog /tshul khrims dag cing mkha' la sgrin/ /rnam par dag cing rgyun gcig la/ /skal bzang spyod pas rnam brgyan te/ /thos nas legs bshad ston par shog /mgo bor bla mas cod paṇa bcings/ /lag pas thabs shes rdor dril 'dzin/ /ngag tu gsang sngags rgyal po bzla/ /yid kyis zung 'jug sgom par shog /'di nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /bla ma lha dang mi 'bral zhing / /sgrub la bar chad med pa dang / /bstan la bya ba byed par shog /bla med bla ma'i thugs rjes dang / /rgyal dang rgyal sras rang rgyal dang / dgra bcom bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /ji ltar bsngos bzhin 'grub par shog /ces brjod/ bkra shis ni/ mtshungs med bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /mthu stobs dbang phyug bla ma brgyud par bcas/ /mtshan nas brjod dam cung zad dran yang rung / /bkra shis 'phel zhing skye dgu bde legs shog /pad+ma'i lte ba bdud bzhi'i steng na brjid/ /yon tan mtha' yas ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /he ru ka dpal bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ /bkra shis 'phel zhing skye dgu bde legs shog /bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung ba'i/

/he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku/ /shes rab phag mo pad+ma rdo rje rol mdzad pa/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /skye med chos sku rang bzhin rnam dag las/ /thugs dam dbang gis gzugs kyi sku sprul pa/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi/ /skye shi med pa don gyi bkra shis shog /'jigs rung dus mtha' sprin ltar gnas pa'i sku/ /hūm̐ phaṭa nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i gsung / /spros pa nyer zhi mkha' dbyings chen po'i thugs/ /dpal 'bar ma hā kā la'i bkra shis shog /gang gi mthu yis brgya byin wa ltar zhum/ /ming tsam thos pas nad do cog las skyob/ /mtshan mo khams gsum nyul ba'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /ma gcig srid gsum bdag mo'i bkra shis shog /dpal brjid mi sdug mthing nag rngam pa'i zhal/ /ral pa dmar ser dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar/ /ljags kyi dbang po glog ltar 'khyug pa can/ /zhing skyong gdong pa bzhi yi bkra shis shog /sprul pa bye bas sa gsum khyab par 'gengs/ /bdud dpung tshar gcod sgrub la dngos grub stsol/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin bu bzhin skyong mdzad pa'i/ /pho nya las mkhan rnams kyi bkra shis shog /gang zhig yid bzhin nor bur gsol btab nas/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub ma lus stsol ba ltar/ /dad pa can kun nam yang mi bslu ba'i/ /dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bkra shis shog /sna tshogs sku gsung thugs kyi sgyu 'phrul gyis/ /gang la gang 'dul mdzad phrin pha mtha' yas/ /dngos grub rnam mnyis stsol ba lhag pa'i lha/ /yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i༞ /pad+ma rā ga'i lhun por tsha zer gyis/ /lan brgyar 'khyud 'dra 'jigs rungs khyod kyi sku/ /gar dgu'i nyams kyis gdug pa kun 'dul ba/ /dbang drag rta mchog rol pa'i༞ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /sna tshogs sku dang mdzad pa rgya mtsho yis/ /phrin las rnam bzhi 'bad med sgrub mdzad pa'i/

/bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i༞ /khyad par gang gi mthu stobs me chen gyis/ /bar chad mi mthun tshang tshing kun bsregs nas/ /dge legs dpal 'byor snang ba'i 'od po che/ /rgyal chen rigs lnga 'khor bcas bkra shis shog /mi mthun rgud tshogs chos nyid ngang du zhi/ /mthun rkyen phun tshogs 'bad med lhun gyis grub/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde nyi ma'i 'od ltar gsal/ /phyogs dus kun tu dge ba'i bkra shis shog /byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ /nor gyi bdag po ār+ya dzam+bha la/ /dbul ba sel ba'i lha mo nor rgyun ma/ /nor lha chos skyong rnams kyi bkra shis shog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang / /mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen dang bral ba dang / /'dod pa 'grub cing phun sum tshogs pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing / /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa'i/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bde legs stsol/ /'dir rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod grogs mched 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad/ nyi ma dang zla ba gza' sgra gcan gyi kha nas thar ba ltar/ spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal nas/ bkra shis dang dge legs kyi 'byor pa'i dpal dam pa thob par gyur cig de dag gi sbyor dngos rjes rnams rgyas par bya ba'i lugs yin la/ gtor gzhi'i drung dngos gzhi 'bring po bya ba 'am/ yang na sbyor dngos 'bring po las/ sbyor ba ni/ gtor bsngos gtor ma dam rdzas lnga tshar gyi dang po kye rdor rta mgrin sogs yi dam/ gnyis pa gur lha brgyad dang zhal/ gsum pa nam mkha'i gos can dang bse khrab/ lnga pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang gzhi bdag bskang gtor gur nas las mkhan bar gong bzhin/ mchod pa dang thun gtor gong bzhin/ dngos gzhi'i mchod pa byin brlabs dang skyabs sems sogs bdag bskyed gong bzhin/

gtor ma byin rlabs nas rta mgrin la nang mchod phul ba'i bar gong bzhin/ de nas/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ gur lcam dral/ zhal las mkhan nam mkha'i gos can rnams la gong bzhin/ bse khrab gtor ma byin rlabs dran pa sngags phyag rgya bcas/ rang nyid rta mchog gsal ba'i mdun gyi gzhir/ /me rlung dbus su btsan rta rag pa la/ /rin chen sga srab sogs kyis spras pa'i steng / /hrīḥdamar 'od zer 'phro 'du yongs gyur las/ /bstan srung bse yi khrab can sku mdog dmar/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum srin po'i gzugs/ /g.yas pa tsan+dan be con klad la skor/ /g.yon pa btsan zhags khra bo thugs khar 'dzin/ /dbu la bse rmog me 'od 'bar ba dang / /sku la dar ljang stod g.yog dar dmar ber/ /bse khrab dmar po sum brtsegs tshul du gsol/ /dam nyams srog rtsa gcod pa'i ral gri dang / /chos 'khor skyong ba'i stag dang gser 'od dang / /bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i gzhu mo gzig shubs can/ /g.yas g.yon glo la rngams pa'i tshul du gsol/ /stong gsum skad cig bskor ba'i rnam pa can/ /g.yas su sku sprul klu btsan mu man mdog /ber nag dgu brtsegs dar nag thod bcings can/ /sbrul nag zhags thogs rta mchog bra nag zhon/ /sprul pa dug sbrul 'bum sde phyogs bcur 'gyed/ /g.yon du gsung sprul bse khrab sku mdog dmar/ /ras dmar thod dang bing chen sku la gsol/ /g.yas pa zhags dmar g.yon pa ba dan 'dzin/ /rta dmar la zhon sprul pa spre'u 'gyed/ /mdun du thugs sprul lha srung sku mdog dkar/ /rin chen rgyan dang dar dkar na bza' gsol/ /g.yas pa zhags dkar g.yon pa rta srab 'dzin/ /rta dkar la zhon sprul pa dge slong 'gyed/ /rje rgyal sku mdog dmar po zab ber gsol/ /g.yas pas rwa lcag g.yon pa dung dkar 'bud/

/rta nag chibs shing sprul pa dpa' bo 'gyed/ /rgyab tu yon tan sprul pa sku mdog dkar/ /dar dkar thod dang na bza' sku la gsol/ /g.yas pa zhags dkar g.yon pa sba lcag bsnams/ /rta dmar zhon cing byi bla sprul par 'gyed/ /mtshams bzhir phrin las sprul pa sku mdog dmar/ /dar dmar thod bcings bse khrab sku la gsol/ /g.yas pas zhags dkar g.yon pa sba lcag bsnams/ /rta rag chibs shing sprul pa sngags nag 'gyed/ /thams cad bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /sku gsung thugs la yig 'bru gsum gyis mtshan/ /rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas/ /chos skyong 'khor bcas badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ /bkra shis lha yi gzhal yas khang chen nas/ /tshur byon tshur byon rgyal chen bse khrab can/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las kun bsgrub slad dang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ bstan srung bse yi khrab can 'khor bcas la/ /phyi nang gsang gsum mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs nas/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul nam mkha'i mtha' klas par/ /kun bzang mchod sprin lta bur 'bul lags na/ /dam tshig dbang gis dges par bzhes nas kyang / /dpal ldan mthong smon dwags grwa'i chos grwa sogs/ /rngog lo chen po'i ting 'dzin bzhugs gnas rnams/ /mi nyams dbyar mtsho lta bur rgyas pa dang / /phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad kun zhi nas/ /rnam bzhi'i phrin las gang bcol myur du sgrubs/ /bdag gzhan dus gsum bsags pa'i nyes kun bshags/ /dgra bgegs log 'dren thal ba'i rlog pa dang / /phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas bstan pa dar/ /'jig rten bde skyid bdag cag dpon slob la/ /nyin mtshan srung skyob bya ra mel tshe mdzod/ /chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /gdug can tshar gcod dregs byed skur bstan pa'i/ /bstan srung bse yi khrab can 'khor bcas la/

/rab dkar dang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mkha' 'gro spyi gtor nas bshags pa rdzogs pa'i bar gong bzhin/ mi dgos pa rnams ni gtor bsngo 'bring po'i lugs dang / bskang rdzas byin rlabs sngags drug phyag drug gis byin brlabs nas/ gur zhal gyi bskang bzlog bstod pa nam mkha'i gos can gyi bskang ba rnams gong bzhin/ bse khrab can la 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyi gsung bzhin bya ste/ de yang / ༈ /srung ma bse khrab can la gtor ma 'bul zhing thugs dam bskang ba'i tshigs su bcad pa phrin las kun 'byung bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bud+dha ā tsar+ya/ 'dir srung ma bse khrab can la mchod gtor 'bul zhing thugs dam bskang bar 'dod pas/ gtor tshogs spyan gzig rnams ma tshang ba med par bshams nas/ bdag bskyed dang mchod pa byin rlabs sogs rang rang gi phyag len ltar byas la sha chen/ tshil chen/ gsur dud/ spos dkar sogs bsregs pa'i bsang du che bar btang la/ mi rkang gi gling bu dang / rol mo sna tshogs kyi sgra rgya cher bsgrags la/ chems rdung dang / gsum rdeg len can blangs nas/ gdung ba'i dbyangs dang bcas 'di skad do// ༈ /hūm̐ phan bde kun 'byung bstan pa dar ba'i gnas/ /gsang phu la sogs bod kyi chos grwa che/ /dge 'dun 'du ba'i gnas rnams skyong mdzad pa'i/ /mthu ldan bka' srung gnyen po bse khrab can/ /'khor dang bcas pa bla ma gong ma yi/ /bka' dang dam tshig gnyen po dran byas nas/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis da lta spyan 'dren na/ /'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gnas 'dir byon/ /zhes brjod cing / rol mo gsum rdeg dang chems rdung gis rjes su che na nyis rdeg la bzhag de nas 'dur gdangs dang bcas 'di skad do/ /hūm̐ ka ba keng rus mi mgo'i rtsig pa can/ /kha bad lcang los byas pa drag po'i gnas/ /ga pur spos dkar gsur du sprin ltar gtibs/ /nga yi srung ma gnas 'dir gdan la bzhugs/ /zhes brjod la/

sngar bzhin rol mo gsum rdeg dang / chems rdung che ba nyis rdeg sogs byas la/ de nas dbyangs gdangs sogs yod med skabs dang sbyar la 'di skad do/ /hūm̐ ca re bshams pa'i mchod gtor spyan gzigs dang / /cha lang rnga dang rkang gling rol mo'i sgra/ /ja chang sha khrag bza' btung sna tshogs pa/ /nya phyis la sogs snod bzangs bkang ste 'bul/ /ta la'i ljon 'dra'i yid 'phrog mchod pa'i rdzas/ /tha mal blo 'das zhing khams kun gang ba/ /da lta blo yis sprul te srid mtha'i bar/ /na rgas skye 'chi spangs pa khyod la 'bul/ /pa re pu re'i chags sdang blo ngan 'dis/ /pha mes brgyud pa'i srung ma'i thugs 'gal ba/ /ba lang lta bu'i bdag 'dras 'gyod pas bshags/ /ma lus byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ /tsa tur las kyi mdangs ldan dar zab dang / /tsha grang gdungs skyobs srog chags pags pa'i tshogs/ /dza re rak+ta 'dzag pa'i mgo phreng dang / /wa dang spyang ki rta g.yag bya nag tshogs/ /zha nye ma 'dres dngul sogs rin chen bdun/ /za ma bcud ldan tshogs 'khor ri ltar spungs/ /'a 'ur snyan brjid dbyangs kyi nga ro dang / /ya rabs dgos pa'i yo byad bsam mi khyab/ /rā hu la sogs las mkhan rngam pa'i tshogs/ /la si seng sogs gos bzang mtshar du dngar/ /sha khrag rus pa'i dmar gtor ri rab tsam/ /sa gzhi ri klung bkang 'dra'i mthun rdzas 'di/ /ha ha'i bzhad sgra sgrog pa khyod la 'bul/ /a yig don ldan chos kyi gnas lugs mchog /bla ma yi dam chos srung rang sems rnams/ /dbyer med shes pa'i lta bas rgyas btab pa'i/ /snang ba 'gag med lhag bsam dmigs pa'i 'phrul/ /bstan srung kun tu dgyes pa'i mchod rdzas 'di/ /sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag gnyen po dang / /da bcol legs pa'i gsol 'debs chen por 'bul/ /dges pas bzhes nas rnal 'byor bdag cag la/ /dgyes shing brtse ba'i mthu rtsal dpung bskyed de/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mi mthun kun zhi nas/

/chos grwa che 'di dar zhing rgyas par mdzod/ /ces brjod cing rol mo gsum rdeg dang / chems rdung rjes su gsum rdeg byas la rol mo rnams bzhag yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang / nongs pa bzod par gsol zhing srung ma'i rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang / med na gshegs gsol/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis sogs rgyas par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di yang gra thang mkhan chen byams pa sangs rgyas bzang pos nan tan du bskul ma mdzad pas rkyen byas nas/ sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos shrī rdo rje gdan gyi gtsug lag khang chen por sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpyod ldan mi dbang rnam rgyal ba'o/ /(shog grang 66nas 69bar mi tshang )'khrugs can/ /bstan 'gro'i don la g.yel ba mi mnga' ba'i/ /chos dbyings zab mo'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khyod kyi yon tan yid bzhin nor bu la/ /dad pas gsol ba btab na dgos 'dod char/ /nam yang zad pa med par 'bebs mkhas pa'i/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i dpal mnga' phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' ltar yangs pa yis/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum mchod 'os bka' sgrub cing / /snyigs dus bstan pa srung ba'i mtshon cha che/ /las bzhi'i lhun po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mdor na khyod sku gang gis mthong ba'am/ khyod gsung thos dang thugs rjes rjes su bzung / /yon tan bsngags dang phrin las yid rangs rnams/ /don yod ldan stsol khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de ltar 'dul 'dzin chos kyi rgyal chen la/ /dad pas bstod cing yon tan brjod pa'i mthus/ /bstan 'gro bdag cag yon mchod dpal 'byor kun/ /dpag bsam shing ltar rgyas pa'i dge legs stsol/ rdo rje'i glu nas bzung / skye shi med pa don gyi bkra shis shog /bar gong bzhin/ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /chos bzhin sgrub par byed pa'i gang zag la/ /bar chad bsrung zhing skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i/

/chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyis bkra shis shog /nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing / /gnod sbyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyi rje/ /byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzam+bha la/ /dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad pa'i bkra shis shog /bgegs rigs sogs gong bzhin te/ 'bring po'i rim pa'o// ༈ /gtor gzhi'i drung dngos gzhi bsdus pa'am/ yang na bsdus pa'i lugs kyi sbyor dngos rjes gsum ni gtor bsngo'i dam rdzas gcig bskang gtor gru gsum gcig dam chos pa thun gtor phud chang rnams kyi sbyor ba'am/ dngos gzhi'i mchod pa byin brlabs/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi nas/ stong gsum gang bar/ bar gong bzhin/ phyag g.yas gsum na/ rdo rje/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ral gri/ g.yon gsum na sdig mdzub mdung thung rgyu zhags bsnams pa/ /zhabs brgyad klu brgyad kyi steng du bgrad pa/ mi mgo skam rlon stag sham sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me nas bzlas pa bsdus pa'i bar gong bzhin/ gtor ma byin brlabs gong bzhin/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi nam mkhar chos 'byung gru gsum sum brtsegs kyi steng mar pad+ma'i ste ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la sku rdo rje lha chen brgyad dang bcas pa/ bar ma'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la kye rdo rje yab yum/ lha mo brgyad/ phyogs skyong brgyad/ 'og ma'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la gsung rdo rje klu chen brgyad dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra/ oṃ ni ri/ sogs chu bzhi gong gi mtshan sngags la/ oṃ in+d+ra/ sogs gtor sngags nas/ kun 'grub shog bar gong bzhin/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma kā ma la ya satwaṃ/

oṃ hrīḥpad+ma ta krita badz+ra kro dha ha yaṃ gṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa i daṃ/ sogs nas/ stsal du gsol/ bar gong bzhin/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi gnod sbyin yab yum/ pu tra/ bha ṭa/ sring mo/ lha mo nam mkha'i gos can/ bstan srung bse khrab can/ 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gur lcam dral/ zhal/ las mgon/ nam gos bse khrab/ gtor sngags lan gsum sogs/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ nas/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /chos bzhin sgrub par byed pa'i gang zag la/ /bar chad bsrung zhing skyong bar zhal bzhi pa'i/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang / gzhi bdag gtor ma gong bzhin/ lha'i tshogs rnams nas rdor glu bkra shis smon lam spyi btab/ rjes chog rnams gong bzhin bya ba'am/ yang na gzhi bdag gtor bsngo rdzogs nas bzlas pa phyi nang gi mchod pa 'dod gsol bshags pa skang rdzas byin brlabs bskang gtor bsngo ba rnams byas la/ ༈ /hūm̐ sku dang gsung thugs rdzu 'phrul nus mthu ldan/ /bstan pa rgyas mdzad nag po chen po dang / /e ka dza ṭi 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ /zhing skyong gtso 'khor gnod sbyin yab yum dang / /pu tra bha ṭa srin mo nam gos can/ /bse khrab can dang sogs/ /phyi nang mchod sprin rgya mtshos thugs dam bskang / /rgya chen gtor ma tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang / /thugs dam nyer dgongs phyag mtshan dam pa dang / /rus rgyan drug gis 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /bdud rtsi sman dang rak+ta gsang rten lnga/ /phyi rten g.yag rog rta dang bya khyi lug /dar nag 'phen dang dgra bo'i don lnga yis/ /nag po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang gyur cig /khyad par gri snying rgyan can dag gis bskang / thugs dam ma bskang snyan sgrub ma 'khyol dang /

/mchod gtor ma grub nyams dang sgrib pa kun/ /nyes ltung tshogs rnams thugs rjes sbyang du gsol/ /thugs dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa ci mchis bshags/ /bstan pa skyongs dang 'gro la phan gdags phyir/ /thugs dam bskang ngo dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /bstan pa srung shig srung ma dam pa rnams/ /sngags dbyangs bstod pa ni gong bzhin/ sngon tshe/ sogs/ lha yi tshogs rnams nas/ rjes chog bar 'bring po bzhin bya ba ste bsdus pa'o/ /de ltar rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rnam gzhag shes par byas nas/ bdag bskyed kye rdo rje byed na gnas yo byin brlabs/ de'i dkyil chog dbu bzhin yin pas bsham gyi skabs chu bzhi dgos/ skyabs 'gro nas dkyil 'khor bsdus pa'i bar lam dus rgyas 'bring gang rung / de nas gtor bsngo bskang ba rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gang byed kyang gong bkod rnams ltar byas la/ mjug chog gi gshegs bsdu grub nas/ rang nyid kyai rdo rjer gsal ba'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ sogs skye mched/ sku gsung thugs bsrung ba sogs lam dus bzhin/ bsngo smon bkra shis 'dra/ yang 'byung 'dul gyi byin na mchod pa byin brlabs chu gnyis ma lags gong bzhin skyabs sems nas/ gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim/ bar/ gtor bsngo gong bzhin la/ 'byung 'dul la byed na/ kye rdo rje rdzogs nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum rgyas par na/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dri ma med pa'i hūm̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ nas/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan bar bdag bskyed bzhin la rang nyid ces pa'i tshig dor gtor 'bul mchod bstod rjes gnang bzhin/ de nas rta mgrin sogs bya/ 'bring bsdus la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas khro bo'i rgyal po 'byung po 'dul byed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gtor sngags mchod bstod sogs bya'o/
